recognize_zh: 高倍切片中一片形態一致的中型母細胞，核圓形至卵圓、部分有核摺痕，染色質細緻呈粉塵狀，核仁小而不明顯，細胞質稀少淡染，符合淋巴母細胞。
features: Round to oval nuclei, some with indentations or convolutions
Finely dispersed (dusty) chromatin with small inconspicuous nucleoli
Occasional apoptotic/hyperchromatic cells; no cohesive or glandular pattern
describe_en: High-power section shows a diffuse, monotonous population of intermediate-sized blasts with round to oval nuclei, occasional nuclear convolutions, finely dispersed chromatin, small inconspicuous nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm. Scattered apoptotic cells are present. There is no cohesive or glandular growth. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic lymphoma; confirmation with TdT and lineage markers is required.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells show multiple nucleoli, squared-off borders, amphophilic cytoplasm and a prominent starry-sky pattern, and are TdT negative.
Myeloid sarcoma may show eosinophilic myelocytes and is MPO/lysozyme positive.
Thymoma contains cytokeratin-positive epithelial cells among immature T cells, which are not seen here.
